rows.text: Every regulation of the Intelligentsia Guild exists for a reason. Take Rule 727, "Prohibition on Collecting Plush Toys," for instance: this ban originally stemmed from three researchers who hailed from Planet Fluff. In their spare time, they hosted a "fight club" with toys they brought from their home planet. Their fight club soon drew in a larger crowd, and competitors scoured everywhere for highly combative smart plushies and various dangerous Curios. The most ferocious among them was the "Ultra-Soft Bear." At the Intelligentsia Guild's Sixth Toy Tournament, Researcher Megaash released all six bears from his crate at once, only to find that they had formed a united front and launched an attack on their master. The Guild swiftly banned all toy fight clubs, because toying with the rebellion of sentient life is no different from "Destruction."
